description_en: Initiates a zonal failover for a PolarDB cluster, promoting a secondary node to primary
name: FailoverDBClusterZonal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node to promote to the primary node. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically selects a node. Call the DescribeDBClusters operation to query node information, such as node IDs
parameters.help_zh: 将要切换为主节点的节点 ID，如果不填，则系统自动选举。您可以通过接口 DescribeDBClusters 查询节点 ID 等信息
parameters.name: target_db_node_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to fail back to the original primary zone after a failover. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否是故障切换后的回切至原主可用区，取值范围如下：

true：是。
false：不是
parameters.name: roll_back_for_disaster

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this token. It must be unique across requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of failover. Valid values:

Primary: A primary/secondary failover within the primary zone.

Standby: A switch to the hot standby storage cluster
parameters.help_zh:
是否是主可用区内主备切换，取值如下：

Primary：主可用区内主备切换。
Standby：切换至存储热备集群
parameters.name: target_zone_type
